display.explanation: Sea Sunday provides a focus for prayer for seafarers and those who support them.
display.prompt: Pray for seafarers, their families, and those who offer care and support in ports.

sentences.label: Sentence
sentences.text: The sea is yours, O God, and you made it; the dry land also which your hands have fashioned.

sentences.label: Post-communion sentence
sentences.text: Your path, O God, was in the sea and your way was through the great waters.

collects.text:
Creator God,
you have made the sea beautiful and fearful;
be with all who sail on it for work or pleasure
and give them safe passage
with Christ the voyager,
who calmed the storm
and strengthened his disciples’ faith.

God of change and invention,
be with those whose life is spent at sea.
In storm, in calm, in harbour,
be with them.
Be with them in danger, boredom or temptation;
for you are God,
you are our hope and strength.
